officialLeads.operator: Oyo State Government, Office of the Surveyor General
officialLeads.scope: Oyo State Digital Land Survey Plan Registry; survey-plan verification for Oyo State, including Oke Iho as an Oyo locality
officialLeads.evidence: The official page states that the service preserves survey-plan records and allows public searches by the name written on a plan or by survey-plan number. It lists basic approved display fields and says coordinates may be used internally to map a parcel.
The official OyoGISS page describes digitised property locations across the state and a spatial data portal, but no anonymous parcel feature endpoint was exposed in this attempt.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.observation: Official registry page loaded through first-party discovery. It documents search by survey-plan name or number and explicitly limits public display to approved basic survey information; no parcel geometry or native ID was returned in the page content.
The official page's Search Now link resolved to this linked survey-search endpoint, but anonymous access was forbidden. No credentials, tokens, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe fields were attempted.
A direct anonymous fetch attempt timed out at 20 seconds; web discovery separately identified the official page and its OyoGISS description. This is not evidence of source absence.
First-party Oyo State lands site was returned by the native-language discovery query and identifies the Digital Survey Plan Registry service. No parcel feature response was obtained.

remainingUncertainty: OyoGISS or the survey registry may expose additional interactive or authenticated mapping functionality. The failed endpoint and lack of exact-point geometry must not be interpreted as citywide absence.
nextStep: A later attempt may inspect any publicly documented OyoGISS map bootstrap or anonymous bounded feature route, retaining only native IDs and geometry if returned.
